title: Privacy Policy
intro: At Lumina Stay, we treat your personal data with the same uncompromising standard of excellence as we do our guest experiences.

sections.collectBody: To provide you with a bespoke travel experience, Lumina Stay collects information that identifies you or relates to an identifiable individual (“Personal Information”). This includes:
sections.useBody: Our use of your information is strictly governed by the necessity of fulfilling our luxury service standards and legal obligations. We utilize your data to:
sections.securityBody: We implement industry-leading technical and organizational measures to protect your Personal Information. Our security framework includes:
sections.rightsBody: As a Lumina Stay guest, you retain full sovereignty over your data. Under global data protection regulations (including GDPR and CCPA), you have the right to:
sections.privacyInquiriesBody: Should you have any questions regarding our privacy practices or wish to exercise your rights, our dedicated Data Protection Officer is available to assist.

collect.title: Identity Data
collect.body: Full name, passport details, and date of birth for international travel compliance.

collect.title: Contact Data
collect.body: Residential address, billing address, personal email, and telephone numbers.

collect.title: Financial Data
collect.body: Encrypted payment card details and transaction history.

collect.title: Preference Data
collect.body: Dietary requirements, pillow preferences, and historical stay details to personalize your concierge service.

uses.title: Service Execution
uses.body: Processing reservations, managing check-ins, and facilitating on-site concierge requests.

uses.title: Personalization
uses.body: Tailoring room settings and curated destination recommendations based on your unique profile.

security.title: Advanced Encryption
security.body: All sensitive data is encrypted using AES-256 standards both at rest and in transit.

security.title: Access Control
security.body: Strict “Least Privilege” access policies ensure only essential personnel interact with your information.

rights: Request access to your data profile
